visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere regional market entry pages. The answer in the first viewport (verdict, four live figures, one source trace, one stamp), every city a row that is a door to its own report, last-full-year closed-sales size with its own population and trace, and a single low-pressure ask. No aggregator publishes the trace under the number.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-12 (P9). Rhythm: no two adjacent sections share a pattern. There is NO cap on how many patterns a page uses (the four-pattern cap was killed 2026-08-27) and the pattern set is OPEN, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb, Instrument level 1, Ledger (cities), Instrument level 2 (closed sales), Ledger (guides), Quiet (FAQ), Sheet (inquiry), Quiet (edges), Footer. THE VERDICT IS DERIVED ONCE and it classifies the RAW months-of-supply value; display goes through formatMonthsOfSupply (lib/format/months-of-supply.ts), never Math.round, so the printed digits never cross a threshold the raw value did not. Classifying the rounded value walks the verdict across a canonical threshold in both directions (4.02 rounds to 4.0 and prints seller's, 5.97 rounds to 6.0 and prints buyer's), which is the CLAUDE.md section 0 defect the repair of 2026-08-12 closed and the 2026-08-13 display-formatter repair closed from the other end. The page's guard is buildMarketFaq's own (months of supply above 0), so the H1 cannot assert a verdict the shared builder declined to answer. D9: the region monthly median series mounts as Instrument.chart, not as a seventh pattern. The city Ledger stays type (each city is a door; a line through cities invents a sequence). Closed-sales dollars publish as whole dollars, not formatPrice, because formatPrice rounds to the nearest $1,000 and the same string goes into the FAQPage JSON-LD. A covered city with no live market row is dropped from the Ledger and linked from the closing Quiet block instead of being synthesized as zero under a live-MLS source line. The KB-era deletions this migration made: KbHero's property search and voice-search button, KbSell's address prefill field, RegionalSfrAlertsBand, CoMarketSizeStrip, CoMarketComposition, KbArticles thumbnails, MarketSources, SmoothScrollProvider. 2026-08-19 (Unit HUB): the long-view section landed — a third Instrument (level 2, id long-view) between the guides Ledger and the FAQ Quiet, carrying the approved chart-room forms as V3ChartCard entries under one KPI row: the YoY rate clock with its 1Y/3Y/5Y/ALL/YoY segmented control, the price and homes-sold switch, real-vs-nominal (CPI), Central-Oregon-vs-nation indexed to 1998, concessions by quarter, and the mortgage-Treasury spread against its full-history norm. Every card title is a finding computed from the same rows its chart draws; every trace lives in a collapsed Source disclosure (Matt 2026-08-19), never a visible paragraph.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + WebPage + Dataset + FAQPage JSON-LD. All four are emitted here: V3Breadcrumb and V3Quiet carry no structured data of their own, on purpose, so one derivation feeds the visible copy and the markup.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Housing market. Surface tone (this page opens on an Instrument, not a dark Stage), current page never a link. The surface tone also clears the fixed public header by default: the trail is the first flow element of <main>, the header is position:fixed, and without the offset the whole strip renders behind the wordmark.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, twice. Level 1 is the page's answer: the verdict headline, then the MOS two-bar (homes for sale vs a month of sales) as Instrument.chart when leftover active and months of supply both publish. Folded tiles carry median list, days to pending, and leftover extra-type/pace/mix. The region monthly median series is the fallback drawing when MOS cannot be derived. Flattening MOS to a 3.9 tile is a defect. Neither level carries an action (2026-08-27 single-ask consolidation): the page previously put a GHOST Value My Home button here, but MarketInquirySheet, the on-page inquiry form, is now the page's one ask and this Instrument answers the reader's question without soliciting one of its own. Level 2 is the last full calendar year of closed sales: a different population, its own trace, and its computedAt stamp ONLY when getCoMarketAnnual returned a mart row, because the live-aggregate fallback stamps now() and would print 'updated today' over a closed calendar year. All three of its figures are doors into the closed-sales explorer, the property-type one carrying its own type filter. That closed year is a singleton status (A27) and stays type.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, twice. Cities: one figure row per city that returned a live row carrying a median, value column = median list price, trace and stamp from the city query itself. Guides: plain rows from getRecentBlogPosts, date through formatDate, no value column and therefore no source line.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, twice. The region FAQ as question-and-answer prose from the same buildMarketFaq array the FAQPage JSON-LD uses, followed by that block's OWN outbound edges (region report, homes for sale, months of supply, the closed-sales year), because pattern 6 is defined as the block that carries the graph's outbound edges and answers naming linkable things while linking nowhere are dead text. Then the closing edge set: every internal link the KB hub carried, the Oregon Data Share citation MarketSources used to render, and any covered city with no live row.

requiredComponents.name: MarketInquirySheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, once, in app/housing-market/_v3/MarketInquirySheet.client.tsx. The page's one on-page ask. Wraps V3Sheet and calls the same route-local server action with the same payload: submitMarketPageInquiry, variant 'inquiry', fields name / email / message. The capture contract is unchanged.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. The canonical sitemap projection (V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS off lib/site-nav) plus the legal row. Carries no button: the one valuation primary belongs to the sticky header. Rendered OUTSIDE <main>, because HTML-AAM maps <footer> to role=contentinfo only when it is not nested in sectioning content, and <main> is sectioning content.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to KbNav today. Not in requiredComponents as itself because the gate checks the route file; the KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs an owned video or photo and is never allowed over a number. The market hub's first viewport is the answer, so the opening is an Instrument. Adding a Stage would also put this route back inside ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay's dark-hero arm, which would then require tone="on-media" on the breadcrumb.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes and embeds in Places. Using it here would make the hub compete with /homes-for-sale and would push the page to five patterns, which the rhythm rule refuses.

deferredComponents.name: KbMarketHud
deferredComponents.reason: The KB HUD is not remounted. D9: the region median year overlay now lives on this page's level-1 Instrument as V3Chart (getPriceHistory region/central-oregon/monthly/60, in-progress month dropped, caller-formatted labels). KbMarketHud stays on the KB register for leftover surfaces that still mount it.

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (dataset entry), variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq, dateModified from the real market_pulse_live refreshedAt. Emitted only when there is at least one variable AND a refresh timestamp.
MetadataBlock schemas array (faqPage entry), items = the same faqs array V3Quiet renders. On the KB page this came out of FAQBlock's includeJsonLd; the payload's meaning is unchanged.

jsonLd.note: One derivation, one answer. The visible FAQ, the FAQPage items, and the Dataset variables all come from buildMarketFaq called once, fed the RAW months-of-supply value. Display on the Instrument, in the FAQ sentence, and in the Dataset variable goes through formatMonthsOfSupply, so a stored 4.02 never prints as 4.0 beside a balanced verdict.

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts. market_pulse_live, geo_type='region', geo_slug='central-oregon', property_type='A'. 10 to 15 minute freshness. Feeds the level-1 Instrument and buildMarketFaq.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts. market_pulse_live city rows, geo_label IN CITY_LABELS, property_type='A'. ONE call. Feeds the city Ledger and its own freshness stamp (newest updated_at in the returned rows).
dataLayer.getRecentBlogPosts: lib/data/blog/getRecentBlogPosts.ts. blog_posts, published, newest first, limit 3. Feeds the guides Ledger.
dataLayer.getCoMarketAnnual: lib/data/analytics/getCoMarketAnnual.ts, year 2024, typeScope 'all'. Closed MLS sales across service-area cities, all property types. Feeds the level-2 Instrument and the two mart-backed FAQ answers, stamped with the row's own computedAt.
dataLayer.getPriceHistory: lib/data/market/getPriceHistory.ts. market_stats_cache, geo_type='region', geo_slug='central-oregon', period_type='monthly', last 60 months. Feeds V3Instrument.chart on the level-1 Instrument after dropInProgressMonth. Labels through formatPriceCompact. Fewer than two finite points omits the chart rather than drawing a confident blank.
dataLayer.submitMarketPageInquiry: app/housing-market/actions.ts (route-local server action) into submitPageCTA. Bound to MarketInquirySheet. Same action, same payload shape, same field names as the KB LeadCaptureBlock it replaces.
dataLayer.note: Every read is a DAL function from @/lib/data or lib/data/analytics (G8). None is wrapped in a swallowing catch: each is resilient-cached with its own documented fallback, so a catch here would hide a real outage behind a confident empty page. Nothing is fetched that the page does not render. Guide rows drop any post whose title or slug is blank rather than passing it to v3Text, which throws by design on an empty string: blog_posts.title is the one DB-sourced string on this page that reaches the barrel and getRecentBlogPosts filters only on status and published_at. Route-local constants live in app/housing-market/_v3/hub-constants.ts, the city Ledger builder in hub-sections.ts, and the V3Chart builders in market-charts.ts so the route file stays under the ci:file-size-budget floor.
dataLayer.getRateChartSeries: lib/data/stats/statsChartSeries.ts. stat_observations via readPublicStatSeries: full FRED MORTGAGE30US and DGS10 histories, aligned into the weekly spread; the norm is the mean over every pair since 1971 and the chart window trims to 2015. Feeds the rate clock, the KPI row, and the spread card.
dataLayer.getNationalIndexSeries: lib/data/stats/statsChartSeries.ts. FRED CSUSHPINSA and CPIAUCSL monthlies from 1998; calendar-year averages (complete years only) feed the indexed-to-1998 and real-vs-nominal cards.
dataLayer.getCoMarketAnnualSeries: lib/data/analytics/getCoMarketAnnual.ts, region SFR, 1998 through the last full year. Feeds the price/homes-sold switch, the indexed comparison, and the real-vs-nominal card.
dataLayer.getConcessionsQuarterly: lib/data/pricing/getConcessionsQuarterly.ts. sale_pricing_seller_net, detached closings with a close price since 2024, grouped by close quarter; the in-progress quarter is dropped at the page edge (dropInProgressQuarter, zonedDateKey).

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator agent, SITE-40 V3Quiet pass, session 019RdEm6 — the table instrument (first viewport at 1440x900 and 375x812, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs, scale 1, palette-quantized) captured by the coordinator against next dev (localhost:3198) on the lane branch with the lane's patch applied and main merged through 0ba0358d (SITE-42's source line) for /housing-market; three independent scorings of one capture run, the median; no page code read, no live page opened. The lane's Opus worktree agent had no Agent tool, so the coordinator ran the evaluators: round one on the lane's own captures (invest 38, compare 30, about 45, market-report 49, reviews 57, contact 49; about drew the scrolling-lists tell on seven glyph-marked doors, contact tied its table mark, and the market hub's source clauses read as internal labels), then a second pass after the class-level fixes — a face in the person door's mark slot, the reviews figure on the reviews door, plain-words source clauses (sourceName) with the trace behind the disclosure, the newest weekly snapshot on the Sales / weekly door — re-captured on the merged tree; then a third pass renamed the two doors the second-round evaluator read as internal labels (Explore → Every closed sale, Sales / weekly → Weekly snapshots) and re-captured; this receipt is that third round. The builder ran on Opus and did not grade its own page. The prior mark is the route's committed receipt (54 on 2026-09-06, grok-4.6, no instrument keys) and the taste table of 2026-09-08 (median 41, scores 44·38·41).
tasteReview.beats: Zillow — every single row on this page carries a named source and an "as of" date plus a methodology-disclosure toggle; Zillow's own market-data entry points show neither on a menu page. No competing page wins on interaction or originality here, since the chooser is still text-and-number rows with no chart, map, or hover reveal.
tells: "icon card grids" — the four-cell grid (By city, Every closed sale, Weekly snapshots, Months of supply) is an icon-topped stat-card repeated four times in an identical shape, visible on both desktop and mobile

"Raw slugs, internal labels or methodology jargon in anything a visitor reads" — the subhead literally reads "Five products", naming the page's own internal inventory rather than a question a buyer or seller would ask
tasteReview.dullest: Weekly snapshots — the only row whose figure is just a date ("Sep 5, 2026") with no live count, verdict, or comparison behind it, so it carries the least reason to click of the five.
tasteReview.verdict: Real progress over the version this replaced: every row now shows a live number and cites its source, which is more discipline than most of this site shows on a menu page. But it is still a directory dressed as a page — five rows built from the same icon-title-number-sentence-source cell, and the one row claiming to hold 'the verdict, the inventory, and the chart' shows none of them here. Keep the sourcing rigor, then make the cells actually carry data instead of pointing at where it lives.

defects.section: By city / Every closed sale / Weekly snapshots / Months of supply grid
defects.finding: Four of the five rows are an icon-title-bignumber-sentence-source cell repeated with no variation in shape — a generic card-grid pattern reskinned in navy/cream rather than a composition a template wouldn't produce.
defects.fix: Give at least one cell a distinct visual encoding — a tiny sparkline on Every closed sale, a small map-pin cluster on By city — so the grid stops reading as four identical templated cells.

defects.finding: The row's own copy promises 'the verdict, the inventory, and the chart, without leaving this page' but shows none of the three in the chooser itself — just one bold number and a sentence, no inline verdict pill or mini chart.
defects.fix: Render a small inline sparkline or verdict pill directly in this row so the richest data on the site previews as data, not as a promise pointing elsewhere.

defects.section: By city / Every closed sale grid
defects.finding: At 375px this pair sits in two ~160px columns, forcing multi-line wraps ('Every closed' / 'sale' as its own line) and cramped padding around the icon, number, and sentence.
defects.fix: Collapse the grid to a single column below roughly 480px instead of forcing two narrow columns.

defects.finding: "Five products" names the page's own internal inventory count rather than reader-facing language; no Central Oregon buyer or seller thinks of these as "products."
defects.fix: Replace with reader-facing framing, e.g. "Five ways to see the market," or drop the count.

The table row for the class (2026-09-08, median 41) is the working prior.
